name: 2024 PJ Trailers USED 32' GN Low-Pro Flatbed  25K
description:
A heavy-duty 2024 PJ Trailers flatbed trailer engineered for hauling equipment, building materials, and oversized loads with confidence.

Every trailer in our inventory is inspected and prepped before delivery. We can ship anywhere in the continental US — call us at +1 (940) 627-1717 or use the form below for a freight quote and to confirm availability.

Standard Features

  • 25,000 lb. G.V.W.R.
  • 10,000 lb. x 2 G.A.W.R.
  • GN 2 5/16" Demco EZ Latch Square Coupler 30,000lbs
  • Safety Chains
  • 2 - Drop Leg Jacks (10,000 lb.)
  • 2 - Oil Bath Brake Axles (10,000 lb.)
  • Heavy Duty Spring Suspension
  • 8 Dual Wheels, 16" Black, 8 on 6.5" Bolt Pattern
  • 8 - 16" 235/80R16 Radial Tires (3,090 lb)
  • Rubrail & Stake Pockets
  • Electric Breakaway Kit w/ Charger
  • DOT Reflective Tape
  • Retractable Monster Steps on Both Sides
  • Lockable Front Toolbox w/ Chain Holder
  • 8' Ramps w/ Holders
  • ProBeam™ Gooseneck w/ 12"x19lb frame
  • TwistGuard™ Standard on 30' and up
  • 3" Channel Crossmembers 16" on Center
  • 2 x 6 x 1/8" Square Tubing Outer Deck Frame
  • 2” APEX Fortified Lumber Deck
  • 102" Wide Deck
  • DOT Approved Flushmount Lifetime LED Lights
  • Amber Side Turn Flashers
  • All-Weather Wiring Harness (7-way RV)
  • Sand Blasted, Acid Washed, Powder Coated
